newsitem.title: USA: Revco made initial $14/shr bid for Big B.
newsitem.headline: Revco made initial $14/shr bid for Big B.

text.p: Big B Inc turned down an initial takeover bid of $14 a share by Revco D.S. Inc, leading Revco to raise its offer to $15 a share, the bidder's offering statement filed with regulators showed Tuesday.

According to the document filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the initial offer was made in an August 5 letter by Revco president and chief executive to Big B chairman and chief executive Anthony Bruno.
The letter followed a meeting of the two executives at Big B headquarters in Bessemer, Ala., on August 1, during which they discussed Revco's interest in Big B, the filing said.
